Definition: from G2936; a founder, i.e. God (as author of all things):--Creator.
BiblicalUsage: The Creator appears once, and it is the name given to God at the end of suffering: "let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator" in 1 Peter 4:19.
TheologicalSignificance: What I take from this is that the title is the anchor of the verse: the One who made me is faithful, so I can commit my soul to Him even when I am suffering and cannot see the way through.
